engineeringSkip.reason: A briefcase-sized source delivering gigawatts for a lifetime has no basis in known physics — fusion power density, neutron and gamma shielding, and waste-heat rejection all make such a device impossible, and it is a fictional gadget rather than an engineering concept.

factCheck.reason: No known physics allows a briefcase-sized device to produce gigawatts of fusion power — containing plasma that hot needs a machine the size of a building, and He-3 is far too scarce to fuel one.
